title: DPC IPO lockup ends — DPC Holdings, 180 days after its 2026-06-24 prospectus
source: SEC: 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2107018/000110465926077968/tm269965-19_424b4.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs). Prospectus dated 2026-06-24 (read from its cover); 180 days after it is 2026-12-21. Lock-up clause: "See "Shares Eligible for Future Sale." Substantially all of these shares are also subject to lock-up agreements restricting their sale for 180 days after the date of this prospectus, as more fully described in "Underwriting." Jefferies LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co."
notes: $919M offering. Insiders may sell from the next session; the pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then.
